requiredEvidence: source-before and source-after manifests with unchanged hashes for each viewport
build hash checked before browser launch and after capture
natural input schedule and every dispatched input with no fixture or debug call
same-object Level1 runway branch projection around the early sharp contact
portrait screenshot/video/trace showing whether the runway trap is recovered
desktop screenshot/video/trace showing the separate white-landing opening branch
player-visible terminal/settlement screenshot with exact completed or failed copy and matching read-only status
visible replay-button click followed by screenshot and read-only ready status
perceptual inspection result for exact branch pixels at mobile and desktop sizes
exactBranchChecks: Portrait must explicitly observe the level1-runway-main sharp contact branch, not only a sibling support.
The portrait branch must not remain anchored at the reproduced early x≈301.95 to x≈329.45 dead-end after the natural contact.
The contact projection must retain support id, part, normal, lifecycle state, player position, and event delta for the same object.
Desktop must record the separate white-landing teaching anchor and must not mislabel it as runway evidence.
Both viewports must reach beyond x>1000 or record a concrete terminal failure cause with matching visible pixels.
A sibling fixture-only pass cannot close the exact natural branch.
terminalChecks: Terminal copy must be exact visible completed/failed copy, not a reward reveal or startup action container.
Terminal visibility must account for effective CSS visibility and nonzero visible pixels.
Read-only game state status must match the terminal classification.
Replay is proven only by clicking the visible replay control after terminal and observing ready state plus screenshot.
perceptualChecks: Inspect startup and runway-contact frames at 390x844 for visible knife/support relationship and no blank/occluded canvas.
Inspect desktop white-landing and later-route frames at 1100x720 for visible causal feedback.
Inspect terminal and replay frames if reached; text and action affordance must be legible.
Any natural-journey or perceptual BLOCKED result remains a release blocker and keeps the cycle QA_PENDING/BLOCKED.
